tagline: Global leader in the design and manufacturing of drug and consumer product dosing, dispensing and protection technologies
hero_kpi_rationale: The packaging and dosing technology sector is highly competitive and requires significant investment in research and development to maintain technological leadership. ATR has a strong tradition of innovation in designing dispensing and product protection solutions, making it a key player in the global market.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses included in selling, general and administrative expenses
kpis.description: ATR consistently invests in research and development to enhance its products and dispensing and protection technologies
kpis.signal: Significant R&D investments to drive innovation in dosing and dispensing technologies

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across global operations
kpis.description: ATR employs approximately 14,000 people worldwide, operating across approximately 20 countries
kpis.signal: Large workforce distributed across approximately 20 countries to support global operations

kpis.name: Long-Term Debt
kpis.explanation: Long-term obligations and debt recorded on the balance sheet
kpis.description: ATR had long-term debt of approximately $1.38 billion as of December 31, 2025, reflecting a conservative financial leverage profile
kpis.signal: Controlled debt level with a consolidated leverage ratio of 1.38x versus a maximum covenant of 3.50x

kpis.name: Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from product and service sales
kpis.description: ATR reported net revenue of $3.777 billion in 2025, an increase of 5.4% compared to 2024
kpis.signal: Sustained revenue growth driven by diversification across end markets

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before interest, taxes and extraordinary items
kpis.description: ATR generated operating income of $501.0 million in 2025
kpis.signal: Stable operating profitability despite inflationary pressures and macroeconomic challenges

kpis.name: Total Debt

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividend amount paid per share during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billion USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.summary: Deterioration in economic conditions could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The company states that deterioration in economic conditions, including inflation, rising interest rates or a recession, could have a significant negative impact on its operations. Customers may delay, cancel or reduce orders in response to economic uncertainty. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk

risks.score_rationale: The company operates in approximately 20 countries, exposing it to geopolitical tensions, trade conflicts and sanctions that could disrupt its supply chains and operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.summary: Cybersecurity threats could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: As a global manufacturing company with significant digital presence, ATR is exposed to cybersecurity threats that could impact its production systems and customer data. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.summary: Competition is high in the company's industry.
risks.score_rationale: The packaging and dispensing technology sector is highly competitive. ATR competes on product innovation and design capabilities across multiple end-market segments. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Risk
risks.summary: Supply disruptions could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: Disruptions in the supply chain for raw materials and components could impact ATR's ability to meet customer demand and create cost pressures. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Global Health Risk
risks.summary: Global health crises could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: Global health crises could impact supply chains, workforce availability and customer demand in end markets served by ATR. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Customer Default Risk
risks.summary: Customer defaults could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: ATR operates with approximately 5,000 customers, none representing more than 4% of net sales. Customer diversification reduces this risk, although defaults may occur in case of customer financial distress. (default score, to be refined)
